metrics.sample: ABOUT / SR–001 / OAKLAND, CALIFORNIA Built by a father. Named for his daughter. SkyyRose began as Corey Foster's promise to build a future Skyy Rose could recognize herself inside. The house keeps Oakland in the frame: concrete, care, memory, and the refusal to shrink. Founded 2020 Origin Oakland, CA Design Gender-neutral THE BLOX / PREMIERE The founder, in his own words. The Blox premiere is not a mood board or a summary. It is the record of the work, the reason for the name, and the city that made the point of view possible. WATCH ON YOUTUBE ↗ THE RECORD The press did not make the story. It documented it. Each source below is the original published feature—not a recreated quote card. MAXIM FEBRUARY 15, 2023 14 Game-Changing Entrepreneurs To Watch In 2023 Corey Foster is an innovative entrepreneur and artist who has created a truly unique clothing line. The Skyy Rose Collection blends fashion with streetwear, creating high quality and beautiful designs people can't help but admire. READ THE ORIGINAL ↗ SAN FRANCISCO POST AUGUST 23, 2024 From Oakland's Streets to Fashion Heights The Skyy Rose Collection, a trailblazing gender-neutral clothing brand, is redefining fashion in the Bay Area and beyond. Established by Corey Foster, a single father with a dream, this Oakland-based brand embodies resilience, creativity, and the power of turning adversity into a catalyst for success. READ THE ORIGINAL ↗ BEST OF BEST REVIEW AUGUST 20, 2024 Best Bay Area Clothing Line Award 2024 The Skyy Rose Collection has been honored with the prestigious Best Bay Area Clothing Line Award 2024 by Best of Best Review. This recognition underscores the brand's exceptional contribution to the fashion industry, particularly in the realm of high-end, gender-neutral clothing that transcends age and gender boundaries. READ THE ORIGINAL ↗ CEO WEEKLY OCTOBER 22, 2024 The Unyielding Journey of a Single Father and Entrepreneur Despite facing numerous setbacks, such as failed website attempts and deceitful manufacturers that promised much yet delivered little, this indomitable spirit refused to be quenched. The Skyy Rose Collection represents hope, hard work, and the relentless spirit of never giving up. READ THE ORIGINAL ↗ FOUR WORLDS / ONE BLOODLINE The V1 lookbook, carried forward. 01 Signature The first mark. Oakland carried forward. → 02 Black Rose Protection, polish, and refusal. → 03 Love Hurts Softness and armor in the same piece. → 04 Kids Capsule The next chapter belongs to the heir. → THE TOWN Deep East · The Hills · Stone City · Lake Merritt · The 510 SkyyRose is gender-neutral by design and Oakland in its posture. The house was built for the person wearing the piece—not for a category somebody else assigned. ENTER THE COLLECTIONS
